calculation.description: When fewer than half of the 15 tradable instruments have positive trailing 10-session returns, rank a long-horizon reversal signal based on negative 20-session return divided by 20-session realized volatility. The signal is cross-sectionally median-centered and zero outside the bearish-breadth regime.

validation.regime_notes: Positive 10-session IC in both evaluated recent regimes; 2020-2024 have no observations because the source panel only provides effective common history for this construction from 2025 onward. Interpret uncertainty conservatively for the 15-instrument cross-section.
